subject: Quantasy onboarding — cyber liability scope, COI, and conditional PO
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.inference>
To: onboarding@quantasy.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 08 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Quantasy onboarding — initial evidence request and PO conditions

Hi team,

Welcome — we're excited to get Quantasy live as a Redwood supplier. Before procurement can issue a purchase order we need a short packet of vendor risk and legal documents so our finance and compliance teams can complete an activation review. To keep things moving, please provide the following by EOD Tuesday: 

- Certificate of Insurance (COI) naming "Redwood Inference, Inc." as additional insured where required, plus policy effective/expiry dates.
- Cyber liability policy declaration page and summary (sublimits for breach response / forensics / notification).
- Confirmation of primary policy territory and whether APAC operations are covered or require an endorsement.
- Signed Subcontractor Attestation stating that any subcontractors processing Redwood data will meet our minimum security controls.
- Completed tax form for US payees (W-9) or equivalent VAT/tax registration for non-US entities.

If you can attach the docs to a reply, call out any policy exclusions or retroactive dates we should be aware of. Per procurement guidance, we can issue a conditional PO (PO will be created and queued) but final payment terms are Net 30 after compliance sign-off and invoice receipt. If there are parts of the request that you expect will take longer, flag them and we'll work out an exception path for limited staging.

Thanks — copying Marissa (procurement lead) and Karthik (vendor ops) for visibility.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Vendor Risk & Onboarding Analyst
Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.inference
(415) 555-0192

[attachment: onboarding_checklist.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]

From: Onboarding Team <onboarding@quantasy.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.inference>
Cc: Priya Verma <priya.verma@quantasy.com>, Legal - Quantasy <legal@quantasy.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Mar 2027 13:07:00 +00:00
Subject: Re: Quantasy onboarding — initial evidence request and PO conditions

Hi Sofia — thanks for the checklist. We're attaching what we have and can provide the rest by tomorrow morning. Highlights: 

- Attached: Quantasy_CyberPolicy.pdf (declaration page + summary), W9_Quantasy.pdf, Subcontractor_Attestation_signed.pdf.
- Our cyber policy includes a $1M each-claim limit with a $250k sublimit for notification/forensics. The insurer is Zenith Mutual; I'll include the broker contact if you need a certificate.
- APAC operations are covered under the primary policy for Australia and Singapore, but Indonesia and India are listed as "Territorial Restrictions" and will require an endorsement. We can request a jurisdictional endorsement; estimated turnaround 5-7 business days.

Attached files: [Quantasy_CyberPolicy.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)], [W9_Quantasy.pdf (PDF, 120KB)], [Subcontractor_Attestation_signed.pdf (PDF, 80KB)]

We'll follow up with the requested endorsement paperwork and a broker letter confirming AM Best equivalent rating. If a conditional PO helps you progress staging for limited test traffic, confirm the PO number or the exact conditional language you require and we'll accept it as part of the contract handoff.

Thanks,
Quantasy Onboarding Team
onboarding@quantasy.com

--
Priya Verma
Head of Operations, Quantasy Technologies
priya.verma@quantasy.com
+44 20 7946 0230

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>
To: Procurement Queue <procurement@redwood.inference>
Cc: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 08 Mar 2027 16:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Quantasy onboarding — conditional PO request

Forwarding: Onboarding provided initial cyber policy, W9, and signed attestation. APAC territory exception flagged for India/Indonesia — endorsement estimated 5-7 business days.

Procurement, please prepare a conditional PO packet for Quantasy (deal QNT-00124) with the following: 
- PO to be issued with "Activation conditional upon receipt of required endorsements for APAC territories; final payment contingent on compliance sign-off."
- Short pay terms: Net 30 after invoice and compliance activation.
- Include a split-invoice code for APAC testing traffic (project: QNT-PROD-PILOT) so finance can segregate early-stage spend.

If procurement policy requires a fully cleared COI prior to PO creation, note that in the ticket and we'll hold. Otherwise, staging traffic can start once the conditional PO is in place and a limited-scope test order is attached to the PO.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.inference

Hi Priya / Quantasy team — received, thank you. We reviewed the declaration and attestation; two quick notes:

1) For the COI, can you ask the broker to add the following endorsement language for APAC operations: "Claims made or reported within the territorial scope of India and Indonesia shall be covered under the primary cyber liability policy with no less favorable limits than listed on the declaration page." If that is not possible, a scoped endorsement with the broker letter confirming coverage equivalency will suffice.

2) Procurement will queue a conditional PO (QNT-PO-4589) today for staging. This PO will have the activation hold noted: "Payment subject to compliance confirmation of the listed endorsements for APAC. Net 30 after compliance acceptance and invoice." Once the endorsement or broker letter is uploaded to the drive link below, compliance will mark the PO active and finance will process the first invoice.

Drive link for uploads: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cQuantasyOnboard
DocuSign for attestation amendment: https://docusign.com/embeddedSigning/ABC123-Quantasy-Attest

If you can confirm expected endorsement ETA and send the broker contact, we'll schedule the activation window.

Thanks — short reply is fine if that's easiest.

Best,
Sofia
Vendor Risk & Onboarding Analyst
Redwood Inference
